intended_use: Flags candidate fraudulent card transactions for manual review.
training_data: Trained on the card_activity feature group from Week 4 using the available transaction data.
limitations: A simple amount-threshold classifier cannot reliably detect low-amount fraud or fraud patterns that are not associated with transaction amount.
ethical_considerations: False positives may inconvenience legitimate customers, while false negatives allow fraudulent transactions to pass through and cause financial loss.
